solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Assistance needed after drinks in Egyptian city

indicators.note: after places the assistance behind the drinks in the answer

parts.note: ports are glasses of fortified wine, so drinks gives PORTS
assistance means aid

explanation.surface: Someone is in need of help after a few too many drinks while visiting a city in Egypt.
explanation.definitionFit: Port Said is a major port city at the northern end of the Suez Canal in Egypt.

clue.text: Erratic progress, initially, by yacht at sea

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of the word progress
at sea means confused or disordered, so the letters of yacht are mixed up

explanation.surface: A yacht's progress across the sea is uneven from the start.
explanation.definitionFit: Patchy means uneven or inconsistent in quality, which is erratic.

clue.text: Disgusting coming from foul pen, a grunt

indicators.note: foul suggests the letters of pen and a grunt are fouled up into a new order

explanation.surface: A grunt from a filthy pigpen is repellent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'foul' looks like part of the picture of the pigpen; it is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Repugnant means causing strong distaste, the same as disgusting.

clue.text: Better talk from me condemned these cheap trips?

indicators.note: condemned suggests the words these cheap trips are wrecked and rebuilt in a fresh order

explanation.surface: Someone running down budget holidays claims their talk is better than the brochures.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cheap trips' looks like a holiday, but the words are the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: This professional helps clients improve their speaking, so improved talk comes from them.

clue.text: One so overdue must get cut off

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
something overdue is late

explanation.surface: A long-overdue bill means the service will be disconnected.
explanation.definitionFit: To isolate is to separate or cut off from others.

clue.text: Swap made by singular magician

parts.note: S is the grammatical abbreviation for singular
a witch is a practitioner of magic, a female magician

explanation.surface: A conjuror pulls off an exchange trick, swapping one thing for another.
explanation.definitionFit: To switch things is to exchange one for another, a straight synonym of swap.

clue.text: This'll help protect a house with rot mounting around her

indicators.note: around says the first group of pieces encloses her

parts.note: rot means decay, and to eat away is to corrode, so rot gives EAT
mounting a horse or bus is boarding it

explanation.surface: Something to shield a home from creeping decay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mounting' looks like a reversal signal in a down clue, but here it simply means getting on, BOARDING.
explanation.definitionFit: Overlapping horizontal boards fixed to an outside wall shield a building from the elements.

clue.text: Group of three in unfinished court case beginning to disagree

indicators.note: unfinished means the last letter of the court word is cut off

parts.note: a court case is a trial

indicators.note: beginning to picks the first letter of disagree

explanation.surface: A trio involved in an inconclusive legal case begin to fall out.
explanation.definitionFit: A triad is a set of three related things or people.

clue.text: Girls' night out in Perth — any drunk?

indicators.note: drunk suggests the letters of Perth and any stagger into a new order

explanation.surface: A bride's celebration in Perth, wondering whether anyone got drunk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drunk' turns PERTH and ANY into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A party for a bride-to-be and her female friends before the wedding is a girls' night out.

clue.text: After mounting, take out famous horse

indicators.note: in a down clue mounting means the word for take out climbs, so it is read upwards

parts.note: to take out someone is slang for killing them

explanation.surface: Once you're on the horse, take it out for a ride.
explanation.walkthrough: Red Rum was the horse that won Britain's Grand National steeplechase three times in the 1970s.
explanation.definitionFit: Red Rum was a celebrated racehorse, a household name in Britain, so a famous horse.

clue.text: Tribe's leader appearing with sword in tent

indicators.note: the leader of the word Tribe's is its opening letter

parts.note: an epee is a fencing sword

explanation.surface: A tribal chief turns up armed with a sword inside his tent.
explanation.definitionFit: A tepee is a conical tent of skins or canvas used by Plains peoples of North America.

clue.text: Undertaking business

definitions.meaning: an undertaking here is a task or enterprise carried out
a business in the sense of a firm or company running its activities

explanation.definitionFit: An operation can be a planned undertaking (a military push) or a business concern (a company's operations).

clue.text: I may raise an issue over breakfast

definitions.text: I may raise an issue over breakfast

parts.words: I may raise an issue over breakfast
parts.note: issue means offspring, a child; this piece of furniture lifts a toddler to table height at mealtimes

explanation.surface: Someone threatens to bring up a contentious topic at the breakfast table.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Raise an issue' reads as starting an argument, but issue is a child, raised physically to the table.
explanation.definitionFit: A tall chair with a tray that lifts a small child up to eat at table level.

clue.text: Monster in filmography — Dracula

indicators.note: in says the letters sit inside the words filmography and Dracula, running across the gap

explanation.surface: A horror monster features in a film list that includes Dracula.
explanation.definitionFit: The Hydra was the many-headed serpent of Greek myth slain by Heracles, a classic monster.

clue.text: Talk in a childish way after dropping soft toy

indicators.note: dropping means the letter for soft is let go from the word for childish chatter

parts.note: to prattle is to chatter like a small child
P stands for piano, the musical direction meaning soft

explanation.surface: A child babbles away after letting a cuddly toy fall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'soft toy' looks like one phrase, but soft belongs to the wordplay and toy alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A rattle is a baby's plaything that makes noise when shaken.

clue.text: Bishop in power, her ideal man?

indicators.note: in places the bishop's abbreviation inside the word for power

parts.note: might means power or strength
RR is Right Reverend, the title abbreviation used for a bishop

explanation.surface: A powerful bishop is perhaps some woman's idea of the perfect partner.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names the perfect partner a woman hopes to find, her ideal husband.

clue.text: Examine face

definitions.meaning: to examine something carefully, as in going over documents
to face a trial or ordeal is to undergo it

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both to study in detail and to experience or endure something.

clue.text: Abandon one's position in rear, having crashed

parts.note: the rear is the back
a computer system that has crashed is down

explanation.surface: A driver in the rear car, having crashed, gives up their place.
explanation.definitionFit: To back down is to withdraw a claim or retreat from a stance in an argument.

clue.text: Traced unusual old design style

indicators.note: unusual signals that the letters of traced are put in an odd new order

explanation.surface: Someone sketched out an unusual old-fashioned style of design.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Traced' looks like the action in the scene, but it is the raw material that 'unusual' reshuffles.
explanation.definitionFit: Art Deco is the geometric decorative style of the 1920s and 1930s in architecture and design.

clue.text: Stale pork pie, perhaps, past it's sell-by date?

parts.note: stale means old, no longer fresh
a pork pie is a style of hat with a flat crown, so an example of a hat

explanation.surface: A stale pork pie that is past its sell-by date.
explanation.walkthrough: A pork pie is a British meat pastry, but also a flat-topped hat; the surface wants the food. 'Stale' looks like the definition but supplies OLD.
explanation.definitionFit: Something old hat is outdated and unoriginal, figuratively beyond its useful life like expired food.

clue.text: Wasted opening in board game

indicators.note: the opening in the word board is its first letter

parts.note: lotto is a game of chance like bingo

explanation.surface: A wasted opening move in a board game.
explanation.walkthrough: Wasted reads as squandered, but here it is slang for very drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: Blotto is slang for extremely drunk, the same as the slang sense of wasted.

clue.text: Old boy turned up with wonderful biographer

indicators.note: in a down clue turned up means the abbreviation for old boy is read upwards

parts.note: OB is the standard abbreviation for old boy, a former pupil
swell is informal for wonderful or excellent

explanation.surface: A former pupil appears with a marvellous writer of lives.
explanation.definitionFit: James Boswell wrote the famous Life of Samuel Johnson, the archetypal biographer.

clue.text: Actress in Street with noble upbringing

indicators.note: in a down clue upbringing means the word for noble is brought up, read upwards

parts.note: a peer is a member of the nobility

explanation.surface: An actress living on a street, raised in an aristocratic household.
explanation.definitionFit: Meryl Streep is a multi-award-winning American actress.

clue.text: Buddhist concept that could make you more relaxed, reportedly

indicators.note: reportedly says we hear the word for more relaxed spoken, not written

parts.note: more relaxed means calmer

explanation.surface: A spiritual idea that might make a person feel calmer.
explanation.walkthrough: The sound match relies on a non-rhotic British accent, where the R in calmer is not pronounced.
explanation.definitionFit: Karma is the Buddhist and Hindu principle that actions bring corresponding consequences.

clue.text: Moved up once reins loosened

indicators.note: loosened suggests the letters of reins are slackened and rearranged

explanation.surface: A rider rose in the saddle once the reins were slackened.
explanation.definitionFit: Risen is the past participle of rise, meaning gone or moved upwards.

clue.text: Soldier or sailor returning on leave

parts.note: to leave, especially to abandon a post, is to desert

indicators.note: returning means the word for sailor is read backwards

parts.note: tar is an old word for a sailor

explanation.surface: A soldier or sailor comes back home on leave.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Soldier or sailor' looks like a pair, but soldier alone is the definition; or is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Desert Rats was the nickname of the British 7th Armoured Division in North Africa, so one of its soldiers.

clue.text: Stubborn stain to be specially treated

indicators.note: specially treated suggests the letters of stain to be are processed into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A stubborn stain will need special treatment to get rid of.
explanation.definitionFit: Obstinate is a direct synonym of stubborn, refusing to change.

clue.text: Engaged by popular demand

parts.note: in means popular or fashionable
use in the sense of need or demand, as in no use for

explanation.surface: Someone is booked up because so many people want them.
explanation.definitionFit: A phone line or toilet that is engaged is occupied, being used right now.

clue.text: Joe, perhaps, quite an age?

parts.note: Joe 90 was a Gerry Anderson puppet TV series; the number is also a ripe old age

explanation.walkthrough: Joe 90 was a 1960s British puppet series about a boy agent; the same number of years is a great age.
explanation.definitionFit: Living to this number of years is a long life, and it completes the title of the boy spy Joe.

clue.text: Chief one in group indicates joint

parts.note: to flag something is to point it out, so indicates gives FLAGS
the hip is a joint of the body

explanation.surface: The leader of a team points to an aching joint.
explanation.definitionFit: A flagship is the leading ship of a fleet, and by extension the chief member of any group.
